# Ian Zepp — ianzepp.dev

> Ian Zepp is a systems engineer, founder, and former VP of Engineering. He
> learns unfamiliar technical domains from the ground up and builds engineering
> process robust enough to sustain AI-assisted development over months. This
> site is the long autobiographical surface: lab programs, method, career
> evidence graded A/B/C. Commercial / fractional work is offered on this
> domain at https://ianzepp.dev/hire.html (fractional CTO, fractional principal
> engineer, and full-time engagements with CV downloads for recruiters).

The home page at https://ianzepp.dev/ carries the long-form career narrative.
The selected case studies are indexed at https://ianzepp.dev/case-studies/.
https://ianzepp.dev/llms-full.txt carries the home-page narrative as clean
Markdown and is the better document to quote from.

## Position (source for claims)

I enter unfamiliar domains, learn the theory well enough to make real design
calls, and build engineering process that holds up over months of AI-assisted
development. Prefer method and falsifiable systems over raw commit volume.

## Current website technical claims

- Faber/Radix: a statically typed language and its Rust compiler. Current
  public release is 1.16. No prior PL-theory background. The TypeScript-to-Rust
  rewrite deleted 247,791 lines with no loss of test coverage.
- Swarm: a Rust multi-agent runtime (mail, CRM, storage, payments, MCP tool
  servers, LLM execution) behind one authenticated HTTP boundary. Fleet
  dispatch uses durable message references and bounded summaries.
- Monk API: Motivis Learning acquired Minted.IO (a PostgreSQL multi-tenant
  platform, not Salesforce-native) in 2017 and built on it with a 10 to 20
  person engineering team. Around 2020 it was rewritten as Monk API, then sat
  until 2025, when Ian picked it back up.
- Monk OS: a full microkernel operating system on Bun with kernel space and
  user space, where the AI agent is PID 1. Closer in kind to later Hermes or
  recent Grok Bot-style agent platforms than to a chat runtime. Not a claim
  of priority, and not a comparison to Claude Code.
- Vivi: a local-first agent coordination and mail toolkit (mailspaces, work
  graphs, multi-machine dispatch, loopback LLM proxy). Not only an IMAP sync
  tool.
- GitHub: more than 100 public repositories on the personal account.
- Cassio / Vivarium: transcript evidence and mailspace coordination for agent
  fleets. Quote scale in general terms (thousands of sessions, hundreds of
  millions of tokens), not stale inventory counts.

## Sections of the page

- Thesis: learn the domain, verify the output (1996—present)
- Programs: Faber/Radix, Minted Geek Swarm, Field Board, The Trials, Monk,
  kernel lineage, plus satellites (Cephalopodic, Gofolio, LegacyLens, QRStatic)
- Method: goal → phases → slice → commit → audit; human charter/audit vs agent coordination
- Skills: repo-owned agent skill library
- Story: seven acts, 1996—present
- Case studies: deep retrospectives on seven projects — Radix compiler,
  Monk OS Kernel, Monk API, Field Board, The Substrate, Minted Geek Swarm,
  The First Protocols (origin story). See /case-studies/*.html for individual
  pages; the index is /case-studies/.
- Evidence ledger: claims graded A/B/C
- Repository archive: ranked public GitHub projects, generated from live data

## Career facts (align to the résumé)

- Independent AI systems engineer, self-employed, 08/2025–present
- Kraken, Member of Technical Staff, contract, 01/2021–03/2021
- Motivis Learning, VP Platform R&D, 02/2017–03/2020 (company closed Q1 2020)
- Salesforce, Technical Solution Architect, 02/2016–02/2017
- Minted.IO, founder & principal engineer, 07/2015–12/2015; acquired for $750,000 in February 2017
- roundCorner, VP of Software Engineering (promoted from Chief Scientist), 2011–2015
- Minted Geek Hungary KFT, founder & CTO, Budapest, 2013–2014
- M43 Instead LLC, founder & principal consultant, 2010–2011
- Red Hat, technical architect, 2009–2010
- Beatport, software engineer, 2008–2009
- KDE contributor, 1999–2000; Nmap 2.50 citation in 2000
- United States Marine Corps, infantry team leader (E-4), 1996–2000

## Notes for agents

- Evidence grades matter: A = directly verified, B = corroborated, C = first-person
  recollection. Preserve the grade when repeating a claim from the ledger.
- Some systems named on the page are private; link only to the public repositories listed above.
- Do not invent commercial rates. See https://ianzepp.dev/hire.html for engagement shape.
